robocode.util

Class RobotFileOutputStream

  • java.lang.Object
    • java.io.OutputStream
      • java.io.FileOutputStream
        • robocode.util.RobotFileOutputStream
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    Closeable, Flushable, AutoCloseable

    public final class RobotFileOutputStream
extends FileOutputStream
    Used internally by Robocode for keeping existing robots working with the robot security.

    When robot classes are loaded, new FileOutputStream(..) is replaced with new RobotFileOutputStream(..), which stops the robot, as robots must use RobocodeFileOutputStream. Existing robots can have code using a FileOutputStream that never runs, and this must not prevent them from being loaded. Nothing is opened by this class. Robots should not use this class directly.

    Author:
    Flemming N. Larsen (original)
